# MCP tools

Each tool answers one text block that holds JSON. When the API refuses, the
tool answers `isError: true` and the text `<status> — <message>`.

`repository` is always the `id` of a repository, from `i18n_repositories`.
`language` is a tag such as `fr` or `pt-BR`. `file` is a file name such as
`common`, never a path.

**Call `i18n_me` first.** It names the repositories and the languages that the
token can write. Then call `i18n_keys`, and send its `commit` back to
`i18n_propose` as `readAt`. Only `i18n_propose` writes: each other tool
only reads, and its MCP annotation `readOnlyHint` is `true`.

## `i18n_repositories`

<Badge type="tip" text="read-only" />

**The repositories to translate.** Which repositories the editor translates, their source language and their targets.

**Input:** none.

The repositories that the account can read. An admin reads all of them. Any
other account reads the repositories where it is a member.

**Answer:** a list of repositories.

| Field           | What it is                                     |
| --------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `id`            | The identifier that the other tools take.      |
| `owner`, `name` | The repository on GitHub.                      |
| `branch`        | The base branch.                               |
| `localesPath`   | The folder of the locale files.                |
| `manifestPath`  | The manifest, from the root of the repository. |
| `publishMode`   | `commit` or `pull_request`.                    |
| `source`        | The source language.                           |
| `targets`       | The other languages.                           |

## `i18n_me`

<Badge type="tip" text="read-only" />

**What this token may do.** The repositories where this account is a member, and in each one its role, the languages it may propose in, and whether it writes the source. A translator writes proposals and does not publish. A reviewer or an owner also publishes.

**Input:** none.

A token gives the rights of its account, and no more
([Access tokens](../agents/tokens.md)).

**Answer:**

```json
{
  "admin": false,
  "memberships": [{ "repositoryId": "…", "role": "translator", "languages": ["en", "de"], "writesSource": false }]
}
```

`role` is `translator`, `reviewer` or `owner`. A translator proposes. A
reviewer or an owner also publishes, in the editor.

## `i18n_keys`

<Badge type="tip" text="read-only" />

**The keys of a language.** Every key of the source beside what one language says about it, filtered by state and by file. The answer carries the `commit` the values were read at; a proposal takes it back.

**Input:**

| Field        | Type                                             | Required | What it is                                                                                                                                                  |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------ | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `repository` | string                                           | yes      | The repository to read, from i18n_repositories. At least 1 character.                                                                                       |
| `language`   | string                                           | yes      | The language to read, which the repository must translate into. Matches `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$`.                                                                 |
| `state`      | `"missing"`, `"review"`, `"translated"`, `"all"` | no       | Which keys to answer. `missing` is what there is work on. `review` is a translation whose source changed: `was` holds the old source. Default: `"missing"`. |
| `file`       | string                                           | no       | Only the keys of this file, for example `common`. Matches `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$`.                                                                               |
| `offset`     | integer                                          | no       | Where to start, for a catalogue past one answer. Default: `0`.                                                                                              |

200 keys for each answer.

**Answer:**

| Field                | What it is                                                                           |
| -------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `commit`             | The revision of the base branch that the values come from. Send it back as `readAt`. |
| `source`             | The source language.                                                                 |
| `language`           | The language read.                                                                   |
| `total`              | How many keys match the filter.                                                      |
| `offset`, `returned` | Where the page starts, and how many keys it holds.                                   |
| `more`               | `true` if another page follows. Call again with `offset + returned`.                 |
| `filesWithNoVersion` | The files that this language does not have. They take no proposal.                   |
| `entries`            | The keys. See below.                                                                 |

Each entry:

| Field    | What it is                                                                    |
| -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `file`   | The file of the key.                                                          |
| `key`    | The dotted path of the key.                                                   |
| `source` | The source text now.                                                          |
| `value`  | The text of the language on the base branch, or `null`.                       |
| `state`  | `missing`, `translated` or `review`.                                          |
| `was`    | For `review` only: the source text that the translation answers.              |
| `empty`  | `true` if the key is left empty on purpose in this language. `value` is `""`. |

The server holds one reading of a catalogue for 5 minutes. Every page of a
listing answers the `commit` of the first page.

## `i18n_key`

<Badge type="tip" text="read-only" />

**One key, with its context.** One key: what the source says, what the target says, and its state. The file and the dotted path are the context — `analysis.requests_export_hint` says what the string is for, and a translation without it is a wrong translation.

**Input:**

| Field        | Type   | Required | What it is                                                                                  |
| ------------ | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `repository` | string | yes      | The repository to read, from i18n_repositories. At least 1 character.                       |
| `language`   | string | yes      | The language to read, which the repository must translate into. Matches `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$`. |
| `file`       | string | yes      | The file of the key, for example `common`. Matches `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$`.                      |
| `key`        | string | yes      | The dotted path of the key, as i18next reads it. At least 1 character.                      |

**Answer:** `{ "found": true, "commit": "…", "source": "fr", "entry": { … } }`,
with the same `entry` as `i18n_keys`.

If the key does not exist, or if the file has no version in the language, the
answer is `{ "found": false, "reason": "…" }`.

## `i18n_propose`

<Badge type="warning" text="writes" /> It writes a commit on the repository, and deletes nothing.

**Propose a batch of translations.** Writes a whole batch as one commit on the branch of its language. Three hundred keys are one commit, not three hundred. Nothing is published: a reviewer does that.

**Input:**

| Field        | Type            | Required | What it is                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ------------ | --------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `repository` | string          | yes      | The repository to read, from i18n_repositories. At least 1 character.                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `language`   | string          | yes      | The language to read, which the repository must translate into. Matches `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$`.                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `readAt`     | string          | yes      | The `commit` the keys were read at, taken from i18n_keys or i18n_key. Every page of one listing answers the same one. It is what lets a publication refuse a key whose source moved since — never invent one, and never mix the values of two listings in one call. Matches `^[0-9a-f]{40}$`. |
| `values`     | array of object | yes      | The whole batch. One call is one commit, so three hundred keys are three hundred keys, not three hundred commits. From 1 to 2000 items.                                                                                                                                                       |

Each item of `values`:

| Field   | Type    | Required | What it is                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ------- | ------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `file`  | string  | yes      | The file of the key, for example `common`. Matches `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$`.                                                                                                                          |
| `key`   | string  | yes      | The dotted path of the key. At least 1 character.                                                                                                                                               |
| `value` | string  | yes      | The text in the language of the batch.                                                                                                                                                          |
| `empty` | boolean | no       | true leaves the key empty on purpose in this language, with value "". Use it only when the source asks for no text in this language, never to skip a key. A key sent without it loses its mark. |

The branch is `i18n/<language>`.

**Answer:**

```json
{ "commit": "…", "branch": "i18n/en", "readAt": "…", "keys": 42, "files": ["common", "checkout"] }
```

## `i18n_proposals`

<Badge type="tip" text="read-only" />

**What is waiting on a language.** The batches the branch of a language holds and the base does not, with who wrote each one.

**Input:**

| Field        | Type   | Required | What it is                                                                                  |
| ------------ | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `repository` | string | yes      | The repository to read, from i18n_repositories. At least 1 character.                       |
| `language`   | string | yes      | The language to read, which the repository must translate into. Matches `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$`. |

**Answer:** a list of batches.

| Field     | What it is                           |
| --------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `commit`  | The commit of the batch.             |
| `message` | Its commit message.                  |
| `author`  | The account that proposed it.        |
| `at`      | When.                                |
| `readAt`  | The revision that the batch answers. |
